reason: The cleaning log and the 25-kid cap are exactly what I look for, and I'd probably use the free visit. But it's a drive for us, and with daycare costs up, $14 plus gas for a single outing is hard to justify. It also doesn't open until next year.
objection: It's a drive for us and gas adds up. At $14 a visit plus gas, a trip costs more than a free library story time or park, so I can't see paying more than once in a while.
would_change_my_mind: If it were close to home or my daycare route, or if the 5-visit pack came in under about $40. Seeing reviews from other parents saying it really stays clean would also help.
